activity_summary: You read it again, slower. By the tenth line Phillips's lips were moving. Burbage asked what he says while all that is said. You told him: Peace, once. He said it was enough. Agnes said an alderman would have you shut. The notes stayed notes. The two lines at the top stayed the size of her.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read slower, and measured the one word.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Fitted the tenth line, and refused a third reading.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Let the second pig pass without a rite.

entities.name: Agnes Tipping
entities.context: Feared the alderman, and kept the sixpence.

facets.activity: Read it slower and gave Burbage Peace, once

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: And what do I say, while he says all that?

quotes.speaker: agnes_tipping
quotes.text: An alderman! You'll have us shut.
